title: Let praise carry what effort cannot
summary: Praise carries what effort cannot drag across alone. Let tenderness stay strong.
lifeApplication: When the heart hardens, lower the tone and tell the truth in a way the room can still receive.

source.shortMeaning: Praise carries what effort cannot drag across alone.
source.lifeApplication: When effort has failed, sing before trying to force the crossing again.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise carries what effort cannot drag across alone.
evidence.turn: Let pain reveal what comfort keeps covering.
